profile.name: Parsa Makouee
profile.headline: I keep the systems behind your business fast, secure and quietly reliable.
profile.intro: IT specialist with 9+ years designing networks, running virtualized infrastructure and administering systems for healthcare, pharma and retail teams. I pair hands-on engineering with a Master’s in Entrepreneurship, so every technical decision is tied to what the business needs.
profile.availabilityText: Open to IT roles and consulting projects

about.title: Engineer by training, problem-solver by habit.
about.body:
I started in computer engineering, writing my B.Sc. thesis on wireless sensor networks for the Internet of Things. Since 2017 I’ve run the infrastructure that real teams depend on every day — from ESXi clusters at a pharmaceutical company to the clinical network of a growing medical practice.

My M.Sc. in Entrepreneurship Management taught me to look at technology the way owners do: as an investment that has to pay off in uptime, security and speed. Today I combine both views to plan, build and run IT that scales with the organization.

services.title: Infrastructure & Virtualization
services.description: Plan, deploy and tune VMware ESXi hosts and virtual machines so workloads stay available and hardware is used efficiently.

services.title: Network Design & Implementation
services.description: Design wired and wireless networks that are segmented, documented and built to grow with the organization.

services.title: Systems Administration
services.description: Windows Server, Active Directory, backups and patching — run day to day with clear procedures and monitoring.

services.title: IT Optimization
services.description: Audit existing infrastructure, remove bottlenecks and single points of failure, and cut costs without cutting reliability.

services.title: Technical Consulting
services.description: Turn business goals into a practical IT roadmap, with options, trade-offs and budgets explained in plain language.

services.title: Web Development
services.description: Responsive, user-centred web interfaces built with Vue.js, React, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.

process.title: Assess
process.description: Map what you have today: hardware, network, users, risks and the pain points your team feels.

process.title: Design
process.description: Propose an architecture and a phased plan with clear costs, so nothing surprises you later.

process.title: Implement
process.description: Build and migrate with minimal downtime, testing every step and documenting as I go.

process.title: Support
process.description: Monitor, maintain and keep improving, with handover notes your team can actually use.
